title: terragucci.run/v1
description: run.json under <prefix>/<project>/runs/<commit>/: the apply of one commit, every wave of it, the roots in each and the roots whose state each reads, and where each wave stands at its gate. Each tf-apply wave job rewrites its own row when it starts applying and when it ends. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

updated.description: When a wave job last wrote it.

roots.description: Each root, its wave, and the roots whose state it reads through terraform_remote_state. Empty for a Terragrunt repo.

state.description: The state its backend block names, which a root of another project may read. Under choudoufu, the records of the estate its live block owns: tofu-records/<estate>, with no bucket.

external.description: Its terraform_remote_state reads of a state no root of the project holds: the block's label and the state it names. Under choudoufu, its terraform_estate_outputs reads of an estate no root of the project owns, as that estate's records. The estate page matches them to other projects' roots.

composed.description: A root in a composed run (waves.compose): wave is the run's, own_wave the wave it would be in on its own, where the dependency order puts it.

reads.description: The waves whose roots' state its roots read.

gate.description: Its gate on the ledger, wave-<n>.

policy.description: The gate policy it ran under: always, on-destructive or never.

digest.description: The set digest its gate decided on.

command.description: The command that approves it, while it waits.

excluded.description: The people whose approval of its digest did not count, because they had a hand in the change, each with the reason, such as bob asked for abc1234.

report.description: Its report's directory, relative to the project's index.json.

shares.description: A wave split across jobs: how many share jobs apply it.

shares_applied.description: The shares that applied; the wave is applied once every share has.

changed.description: The roots whose plan in this wave changes a resource or an output: where the run's blast radius starts.

totals.description: The wave's changes by action (create, update, replace, delete, read, no-op, forget), as its report's totals counts them, once it planned. Written by the job that plans the whole wave, not by a share of it.

totals_roots.description: How many of the wave's roots totals counts a change of: each root whose plan creates, updates, replaces, deletes or forgets a resource, less a root the policy refused.

spans.description: The wave's time, oldest first: each plan, each wait at its gate (no end while it waits) and each apply (no end while it applies). At most 24.

share.description: The share of a wave split across jobs that planned or applied.

progress.description: A choudoufu wave's resources while it applies and once it ended: each change its plans make, done, in flight, waiting or not applied, as its estates' records stood at the last read.

read.description: When the records were last read.

done_at.description: When a read first found it done.

composed.description: The wave whose job runs a composed run (waves.compose): its roots, upstreams first; the composed plan's digest once planned; the roots that read a value unknown at plan time; and, once the apply ended, how each root's part of it ended and its state. A wave whose roots all moved into the run keeps its row with no roots.
